name: vst-claude-acp-vendor
description: Not a real package — pins the exact @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp version scripts/install-claude-acp-vendor.sh installs (bun install --omit=optional) so the daemon can run it via `bun` directly, with no system Node.js install needed. See rust/vst-agents/src/claude.rs's `claude_acp_entry_path()`.
